data.title: 泽塔 · 据点浴室的水汽
data.description: 潜伏三日归来的泽塔终于泡进据点的浴池。水汽里，她把长发盘起，只露出线条利落的肩背，金色的尾巴搭在池沿上慢慢甩着水珠。门外有脚步声时，猫耳会先一步竖起来。
data.action: 泡在浴池里盘起长发，尾巴搭在池沿，猫耳警觉地竖起
data.lighting: soft steam-diffused lamplight in a stone bath
data.promptProse: Soaking in the hideout bath after three days undercover, adult Zeta pins up her golden hair, bare shoulders above the water, tail flicking droplets off the stone rim.
data.animaCaption: Steam, silence, and one ear always up — even in the bath, Zeta is never fully off duty.
